UI_BetterContainers_Options_allowReorder: Koly uvimkneno, dozvoliaie zminiuvaty poriadok knopok konteineriv inventariu, vkliuchno z knopkamy hravtsia.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_showAdvanced: Koly uvimkneno, pokrashchuie katehorii vidobrazhennia predmetiv u paneli inventariu (mozhlyva nevelyka zatrymka pid chas uvimknennia).
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableCustom: Koly uvimkneno, dozvoliaie nalashtovuvaty knopky konteineriv inventariu.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableProxim: Uvімkaye abo vymykaye funktsiiu inventariu blyzkosti.
Klavisha, yaka vykorystovuietsia dlia peremykannia funktsii inventariu blyzkosti.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_forceProximi: Klavisha, yaka vykorystovuietsia dlia prymusovoho blokuvannia inventariu blyzkosti.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableProxim: Uvімkaye abo vymykaye pidsvichuvannia konteineriv i trupiv.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableCorpse: Uvімkaye abo vymykaye inventar blyzkosti v rezhymi lyshe trupy.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_corpseOnlyMo: Klavisha, yaka vykorystovuietsia dlia prymusu rezhymu lyshe trupy.
UI_BetterContainers_Options_enableAutoLo: Koly uvimkneno, klavisha blokuvannia ignoruietsia, a blokuvannia stae avtomatychnym. Hravtsi mozhut perehliadaty inventari, a pislia viddalennia abo pislia 10 khvylyn u hri vybranyi inventar povertaietsia do inventariu blyzkosti/cherez trupy.
